description: This file defines the PortalPageWorker class, which provides utility methods for managing portal pages within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving portal pages by ID or parent, rendering pages as text, and checking user permissions for configuration.

classes.name: PortalPageWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for portal page retrieval, rendering, and permission checking within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: renderPortalPageAsTextExt
methods.description: Renders the specified portal page as a text string. Currently, this method returns a fixed string "success".

methods.name: getPortalPages
methods.description: Retrieves a list of portal pages that have the specified parent ID, considering user-specific private pages if a user is logged in.

methods.name: getPortalPage
methods.description: Retrieves a single portal page by ID, prioritizing user-specific private pages if available.

methods.name: userIsAllowedToConfigure
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has permission to configure the specified portal page, based on ownership or admin permissions.
